extracted.intended_audience: fire, EMS, and emergency management public information officers (PIOs); personnel who work with media or manage social media; PIO leadership/chief officers
extracted.subtask_description: A catalogue of customizable training modules and FEMA-aligned courses designed to teach public information officers (PIOs) and related personnel media relations, social/digital communication, crisis messaging, on-camera/interview skills, and incident-specific PIO functions. Includes basic, advanced, position-specific, and exercise-based training options.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audience and experience tailoring
rubrics_metrics.description: Training can be designed for new to semi-experienced PIOs, as well as any personnel who may work with the media or manage social media.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Modules are customizable to participant experience levels; specify whether course is for entry-level, experienced PIOs, or chiefs when designing training.

rubrics_metrics.name: Social media: best practices and platforms
rubrics_metrics.description: Teach best practices for social media use and platform-specific approaches for PIOs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers which platforms to use, platform norms, and practical guidance for posting, engagement, and rapid public information delivery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Writing news releases
rubrics_metrics.description: Instruction on composing news releases for public safety agencies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes structure, essential elements, clarity, and timeliness for advisories and releases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Basic on-camera skills
rubrics_metrics.description: Fundamentals of appearing on camera for interviews and public messaging.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers presence, delivery, body language, and simple technical considerations for on-camera appearances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Managing fire and EMS scenes
rubrics_metrics.description: PIO roles and actions when present at fire and EMS incident scenes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes safety, access control, coordination with incident command, and balancing information flow with scene operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Handling on-scene media
rubrics_metrics.description: Techniques for managing reporters and camera crews at incident scenes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers media staging, escorts, press lines, information release points, and protecting scene integrity while facilitating coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Developing message mapping and talking points
rubrics_metrics.description: Creating clear message maps and succinct talking points for PIOs to use in media interactions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes consistency, priority messages, audience-tailoring, and bridging/back-bridging techniques.

rubrics_metrics.name: Crisis communications
rubrics_metrics.description: Advanced training in communicating during crises and managing reputation under stress.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes planning, rapid decision-making, holding statements, rumors/misinformation management, and post-incident messaging strategies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Handling a line-of-duty death (LODD)
rubrics_metrics.description: Specialized training on PIO responsibilities and messaging when an LODD occurs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers bereavement protocols, family notifications, sensitivity in public statements, coordination with leadership, and media management.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strategic messaging
rubrics_metrics.description: Designing and delivering messages aligned with strategic objectives and audience analysis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes setting communication goals, objectives, media analysis, and measuring message effectiveness.

rubrics_metrics.name: On-camera interview techniques
rubrics_metrics.description: Advanced interview skills specifically for camera interviews and media scrutiny.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practice-based techniques for handling tough questions, staying on message, and nonverbal signaling on camera.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conducting news conferences
rubrics_metrics.description: Planning and executing news conferences and media briefings effectively.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses logistics, speaker selection, Q&A management, staging, and ensuring clear public information delivery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wellness for experienced PIOs and chiefs
rubrics_metrics.description: Training focused on wellness considerations for seasoned PIOs and agency leadership.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May include stress management, burnout prevention, peer support, and organizational resilience strategies.

rubrics_metrics.name: First Amendment auditors
rubrics_metrics.description: Training on interacting with or responding to First Amendment auditors who test public-records or recording rights.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers legal boundaries, officer/PIO response strategies, and maintaining public access while protecting safety.

rubrics_metrics.name: Artificial intelligence (AI) implications
rubrics_metrics.description: Education about AI tools and issues relevant to PIO work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May include AI-assisted content creation, misinformation detection, ethical considerations, and monitoring tools.

rubrics_metrics.name: Working under national media scrutiny
rubrics_metrics.description: Preparing PIOs and leadership to operate when national media are covering incidents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers heightened messaging discipline, coordination with external agencies, and managing wide-reaching narratives.

rubrics_metrics.name: PIO+ Course (FEMA L0105 + custom subjects)
rubrics_metrics.description: A combined FEMA L0105 Public Information Basics course augmented with custom subjects tailored to agency needs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when basic FEMA curriculum is desired plus additional local/advanced topics; contact training specialists for customization and cost discussion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public Information Basics Course (FEMA L0105)
rubrics_metrics.description: FEMA L0105 three-day foundational course for public information officers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standard FEMA curriculum covering essential PIO functions; listed duration: 3-day course.

rubrics_metrics.name: All Hazards – Position Specific Course – PIO (FEMA L0952)
rubrics_metrics.description: FEMA L0952 five-day position-specific training for PIOs addressing all-hazards responsibilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended as an in-depth, five-day course focused on role-specific skills and coordination.

rubrics_metrics.name: All Hazards – Position Specific Course – Liaison Officer (FEMA L0956)
rubrics_metrics.description: FEMA L0956 two-day position-specific liaison officer training addressing all-hazards coordination roles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Two-day course useful when agency needs liaison-specific skills alongside PIO functions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Custom Designed Advanced/Complex PIO curriculum
rubrics_metrics.description: Bespoke courses designed specifically for a host agency, including advanced and complex PIO topics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Training specialists will work with host agency to design content and costs; ideal for agency-specific scenarios and policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conference Speaker
rubrics_metrics.description: Provision of PIO-focused subject-matter experts to speak at conferences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Can be scheduled as single presentations; useful for broader education and thought leadership.

rubrics_metrics.name: Table Top Exercise (PIO)
rubrics_metrics.description: Facilitated tabletop exercise focused on PIO roles and decision-making.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to practice plans and messaging in a low-stress, discussion-based environment (TTX).

rubrics_metrics.name: Functional Exercise (PIO)
rubrics_metrics.description: A higher-fidelity exercise simulating PIO operational functions under more realistic conditions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful for testing workflows, coordination, and real-time message drafting/approval processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Panel Discussion (PIO)
rubrics_metrics.description: Facilitated panel-format discussion on PIO topics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Good for sharing diverse perspectives and lessons learned across agencies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Relationships, trust and credibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Training on building relationships and establishing trust and credibility with communities and media.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes long-term reputation management and community engagement practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Your first day on the job: recommendations from PIOs
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical advice and do's/don'ts for new PIOs based on practitioner experience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers immediate priorities, common pitfalls, and establishing routines.

rubrics_metrics.name: NIMS/ICS overview for the PIO
rubrics_metrics.description: An overview of National Incident Management System (NIMS) and Incident Command System (ICS) concepts tailored to PIO responsibilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains PIO position in ICS structure and coordination with command staff.

rubrics_metrics.name: Essential elements of information
rubrics_metrics.description: Instruction on identifying and communicating essential elements of information (EEIs) during incidents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on what the public and media need to know, prioritization, and accuracy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of video and images
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on selecting, producing, and distributing video and photographic content for public information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers ethics, privacy/safety considerations, file formats, captions, and platform best practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: JIS/JIC operations for the PIO
rubrics_metrics.description: Training on operating within a Joint Information System (JIS) or Joint Information Center (JIC).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers multi-agency coordination, shared messaging, and information flow protocols.

rubrics_metrics.name: Managing media at events (includes TTX)
rubrics_metrics.description: Practices for media management during public events and exercises, often including tabletop components.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes staging, access control, media briefings, and contingency planning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digital media and storytelling
rubrics_metrics.description: Using digital platforms and storytelling techniques to engage the public effectively.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers narrative structure, audience engagement, multimedia content strategies, and platform tailoring.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interview skills
rubrics_metrics.description: Training to prepare PIOs for one-on-one and group interviews with journalists.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on message discipline, bridging, soundbites, and handling difficult or misleading questions.

rubrics_metrics.name: News conference skills
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical skills for organizing and delivering effective news conferences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes speaker prep, staging, media invitation lists, and managing live Q&A.

rubrics_metrics.name: Social media influencers
rubrics_metrics.description: Understanding and engaging with social media influencers as part of public information strategy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers vetting, partnership considerations, and amplification strategies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Social media policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on developing and enforcing social media policies for agencies and personnel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes acceptable use, posting approvals, and consequences for policy violations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Empathy statements
rubrics_metrics.description: Crafting empathetic messaging as part of public communication, especially during crises or tragedies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes sincerity, audience sensitivity, and appropriate tone.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media monitoring
rubrics_metrics.description: Systems and practices for monitoring media coverage and public sentiment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes tools, workflows for tracking misinformation, and using monitoring outputs to inform messaging.

rubrics_metrics.name: Behavioral health considerations for PIOs
rubrics_metrics.description: Addressing behavioral health impacts on PIOs and incorporating behavioral health into communications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers mental health support, messaging about behavioral health resources, and considerations when communicating about trauma.

rubrics_metrics.name: Demographics and community understanding
rubrics_metrics.description: Training in tailoring messages based on community demographics and needs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes cultural competency, language access, and outreach to vulnerable populations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recovery operations and the PIO role
rubrics_metrics.description: Role of the PIO during recovery phases after an incident.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on long-term messaging, resource information, community updates, and rebuilding trust.

rubrics_metrics.name: Professional organizations and accreditation
rubrics_metrics.description: Information on professional PIO organizations and accreditation opportunities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers benefits of membership, credentialing pathways, and continuing education.

rubrics_metrics.name: Crisis communications planning
rubrics_metrics.description: Developing crisis communications plans tailored to agency risks and operational context.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes templates, roles/responsibilities, triggers, and approval workflows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Crisis communications and reputation management
rubrics_metrics.description: Strategies for protecting and restoring organizational reputation during and after crises.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes proactive reputation building, response sequencing, and post-incident evaluation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conducting an initial media briefing or news conference (TTX)
rubrics_metrics.description: Tabletop exercise focused specifically on conducting the initial media briefing or news conference following an incident.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Scenario-based practice of initial statements, Q&A handling, and coordination with incident command.

rubrics_metrics.name: PIO, media and a line-of-duty death
rubrics_metrics.description: Focused training on interactions among PIOs, media, and families in the event of a line-of-duty death.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers sensitivity, timing of releases, legal/privacy concerns, and multi-agency coordination.

rubrics_metrics.name: NIMS/ICS overview: command staff perspectives
rubrics_metrics.description: An ICS/NIMS overview framed from the perspective of command staff to help PIOs understand higher-level decision-making.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Helps PIOs align messaging with command intent and constraints.

rubrics_metrics.name: Managing a challenging interview
rubrics_metrics.description: Skills and tactics for handling adversarial or high-pressure interviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes de-escalation, bridging techniques, and staying on-message under provocation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Having a seat at the table (leadership integration)
rubrics_metrics.description: Strategies for integrating PIOs into leadership decision-making and earning a voice in planning.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on demonstrating value, relationship-building with command, and proactive engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conducting a successful news conference
rubrics_metrics.description: Comprehensive practices to ensure news conferences meet communication objectives and run smoothly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes planning, clear roles, rehearsal, and post-conference follow-up.

rubrics_metrics.name: PIO functions with and without incident commander approval
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on actions PIOs can take independently versus those requiring incident commander approval.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarifies boundaries for releasing information and escalation protocols.

rubrics_metrics.name: Following IC direction
rubrics_metrics.description: Adhering to incident command direction when executing communications activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlights chain-of-command, approval processes, and when to seek clarification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strategic communications with goals, objectives and media analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: Combining strategic planning with measurable goals, objectives, and media analysis to guide PIO efforts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes crafting KPIs, analyzing media reach/impact, and adjusting tactics based on analysis.
